prompt:
Capture It - Game Features Script

Capture It is a friends-only creative video-making game where players can create, film, and share all kinds of content.

Players can make movies, videos, Shorts, animations, roleplays, and livestreams all within one platform.

The movie editor allows users to build stories scene by scene. Players can choose thumbnails, add sounds, place characters, set poses, adjust camera angles, and fully control how each scene looks and feels.

Filming takes place across a variety of built-in maps such as cities, schools, castles, beaches, and forests. Players also have the ability to build their own maps or copy existing ones and customize them freely.

Capture It includes a wide range of free extensions. These include AI Summaries, the BrightUp Thumbnail Editor, a Video Title Generator, a Thumbnail Tester, additional video assets, and special packs like the Pirate Pack. No Robux is required to access these tools.

Players can enhance their videos using many different assets such as trees, sharks, ocean items, plants, rocks, pirate props, furniture, and visual effects to make each scene more detailed and unique.

Captions can be enabled so viewers can read dialogue and chat clearly, even when audio is not available.

Profiles can be customized with banners, playlists, connected videos, favorite creations, and featured thumbnails to showcase a creator's work.

Videos can be promoted to help reach a larger audience and grow visibility. Promoted videos can be skipped instantly by viewers.

The game also includes copyright protection tools to help safeguard original creations. Reports are reviewed to maintain fairness and support a creative community.

In addition to creation tools, players can enjoy mini games or use special maps as filming locations for their projects.

Capture It is built around creativity, storytelling, and sharing-giving players everything they need to create and express their ideas.

These zones are arranged around a central open filming area that allows flexible camera placement and scene setup. Include scattered props such as pirate-themed items, furniture, and visual effects elements distributed throughout the map to enable detailed scene customization. The layout supports easy navigation between zones and provides varied terrain and structures suitable for creative video-making, roleplays, and animations. The environment is designed to be modular and customizable, allowing players to build or modify maps freely while maintaining a cohesive, camera-friendly composition.

prompt:
Crea un juego de Roblox llamado "MM2 Aim Trainer". El objetivo es ayudar a los jugadores a mejorar su puntería para juegos como Murder Mystery 2. El mapa debe ser moderno, con una estética oscura y luces neón azules y rojas. Agrega un lobby con botones para elegir distintos modos de entrenamiento.
Modos de entrenamiento:
Targets Estáticos: Blancos inmóviles para practicar precisión.
Targets en Movimiento: Objetivos que se mueven a diferentes velocidades y direcciones.
Sheriff Trainer: Bots que simulan jugadores corriendo, saltando y cambiando de dirección para practicar disparos como sheriff.
Reaction Test: Objetivos aparecen aleatoriamente y desaparecen rápidamente para mejorar los reflejos.
Flick Shot: Los objetivos aparecen en posiciones aleatorias para entrenar disparos rápidos.
Tracking: Objetivos que se desplazan constantemente y deben mantenerse apuntados.
Características:
Contador de precisión (%).
Tiempo de reacción en milisegundos.
Estadísticas de disparos acertados y fallados.
Sistema de récords personales.
Tabla de clasificación (Leaderboard).
Configuración de sensibilidad de cámara.
Interfaz moderna con animaciones suaves.
Efectos de sonido al acertar y fallar.
Tutorial para jugadores nuevos.
Optimizado para PC y dispositivos móviles.
El juego debe sentirse como un entrenador profesional de aim, con una interfaz limpia, rendimiento fluido y mecánicas diseñadas para mejorar la precisión y velocidad de reacción de los jugadores de Murder Mystery 2.
enriched: Build a modern, dark-themed 3D Roblox map for an aim training game called "MM2 Aim Trainer" featuring neon blue and red lighting throughout. The scene opens with a sleek lobby area in the foreground, illuminated by glowing neon accents and containing clearly visible buttons arranged neatly for selecting different training modes. Beyond the lobby, create distinct training zones arranged side by side or in a semi-circle layout: a static target range with immobile white targets; a moving target area where targets travel at varying speeds and directions; a sheriff trainer zone populated with bots simulating running, jumping, and directional changes; a reaction test space where targets appear and vanish quickly at random positions; a flick shot area with targets spawning unpredictably; and a tracking zone with continuously moving targets that players must keep aimed at. The overall environment should feel professional and clean, with smooth animations and a minimalistic interface integrated into the space. Use dark surfaces contrasted by vibrant neon lighting to enhance visibility and focus. The layout supports fluid player movement and clear sightlines to all target zones, optimized for both PC and mobile devices. Include subtle sound effect props and tutorial signage near the lobby to reinforce the training atmosphere.
